description: 先手对王②：正确路线——1.d4 先推兵，2.Kc6 侧翼迂回，白王踏上关键格赢棋

intro.popup_en: The key squares are c6, d6, and e6. White can first advance the pawn, forcing the black king to move and allowing White to take the opposition.
intro.popup: 💡 先手对王：目前争夺的关键格是 c6、d6、e6。白现有机会走一步兵，迫使黑王移动， 取得先手对王机会！

outro.popup_en: To win a king-and-pawn ending, the pawn must promote. Taking the opposition is the key technique.
outro.popup: 🏆 <b>结论：王兵对王的残局，要取胜必须兵升变， 先手对王是关键！

moves.popup_en: 1. d4! Advance the pawn first, forcing the black king to move and giving White the opposition.
moves.popup: ⭐ 1.d4! — 先推兵！等待黑王移动，取得先手对王机会。

moves.popup_en: ...Ke7: the black king is forced to move to the right.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke7 — 黑王被迫选择右移。

moves.popup_en: 2. Kc6! The white king takes the flank route to the key square c6. Black cannot control c6 and the other key squares at once.
moves.popup: ⭐ 2.Kc6! — 侧翼迂回！白王争取到c6的关键格，黑王无法同时封锁c6！

moves.popup_en: ...Ke8: the black king is forced to the back rank and has lost the opposition.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke8 — 黑王被迫退到底线，对王已失。

moves.popup_en: 3. d5: the pawn advances with the white king on c6 to support it.
moves.popup: ♟ 3.d5 — 兵向前！白王 c6，兵 d5，协同推进。

moves.popup_en: ...Kd8: the black king holds the eighth rank and blocks from the front.
moves.popup: ♚ Kd8 — 黑王守住 d8，正面拦截。

moves.popup_en: 4. Kd6! The white king reaches the key square d6 and takes the opposition. Promotion is now assured.
moves.popup: ⭐ 4.Kd6 — 白王踏上关键格 d6！继续先手对王! 升变已无悬念。

moves.popup_en: ...Ke8: the black king can only watch from the back rank.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke8 — 黑王眼望底线，无计可施。

moves.popup_en: 5. Kc7: the white king escorts the pawn forward.
...Ke7: the black king makes one last attempt to block.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke7 — 黑王最后挣扎，试图拦截。

moves.popup_en: 6. d6+ checks, forcing the black king to give way.
...Ke6: the black king moves next to the pawn for one last defense.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke6 — 黑王贴兵，最后防守。

moves.popup_en: 7. d7: the pawn is one step from promotion.
...Ke5: the black king abandons d8 and cannot stop promotion.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke5 — 黑王放弃 d8，无路可挡。

moves.popup_en: 8. d8=Q promotes. The key sequence was 1. d4 to gain the opposition, followed by 2. Kc6 via the flank.
moves.popup:
👑 8.d8=Q — 升后！白方赢棋！
核心：1.d4 先推兵 + 2.Kc6 侧翼迂回 = 先手对王标准套路。
